# Azzi Studios

> Azzi Studios is a creative studio based in Beirut, Lebanon, founded in 2024 by an architect. It produces campaigns, visual content, VM & window displays, visual identities and social media management for fashion, luxury, beauty, jewellery, lifestyle, gastronomy, spirits, automotive and culture & arts brands — across Lebanon, the GCC (Dubai, Saudi Arabia) and internationally. Contact: hello@azzistudios.com.

## Studio
- [Work](https://azzistudios.com/): portfolio of campaigns, shoots, set design and window displays
- [About](https://azzistudios.com/about): the studio, its founder and its sectors
- [Services](https://azzistudios.com/services): the five services in detail
- [FAQ](https://azzistudios.com/faq): where we are based, how projects run, GCC production
- [Contact](https://azzistudios.com/contact): email and WhatsApp

## Services
- [Campaign Production](https://azzistudios.com/campaign-production): creative direction, art direction, photography, videography, set design
- [Visual Content](https://azzistudios.com/visual-content): product photography, lookbooks, reels, monthly content
- [VM & Window Display](https://azzistudios.com/vm-window-display): window displays, visual merchandising, retail environments
- [Visual Identity](https://azzistudios.com/visual-identity): logo, typography, colour systems, brand guidelines, packaging
- [Social Media Management](https://azzistudios.com/social-media): strategy, calendars, community management, paid social
- [Campaign Production — GCC](https://azzistudios.com/campaign-production-gcc): campaign production across the GCC, Dubai and Saudi Arabia
- [Restaurant & Hospitality Branding](https://azzistudios.com/restaurant-hospitality-branding): branding and content for F&B and hospitality
